label: The 32-of-44 number is reproduced by the committed check and the whole gap is one folder: --check prints visibility claude 32/44, cursor 44/44 with 256 mirrors across 10 trees, and .claude/commands/create holds 13 command files of which Claude shows one while the other 31 foldered commands sit outside create/ and all show.

No other runtime hides a command: of 45 canonical command files each tree resolves 45 of 45, cursor, codex, pi and dsh through flat files and opencode through a top-level folder entry, so every Claude-side option costs the other runtimes nothing.

The collapse trigger is the exact basename skill.md and today's single visible entry is the skill named create, so the name to preserve is create and the twelve names to restore are create:agent, create:benchmark, create:changelog, create:command, create:diff, create:feature-catalog, create:goal, create:manual-testing-playbook, create:readme, create:repo-rule, create:skill-parent and create:with-human-voice.

The count function has two blind spots that would let a false 44 pass: commandVisibility skips any root-level command so local-skilled-alignment.md is in neither numerator nor denominator, and it counts a folder holding skill.md as exactly one whatever Claude does, so a case-only rename would print 44/44 from the script whether or not Claude still collapses.

Option 1, a generated Claude skill beside the command tree, restores 44 of 44 with every displayed name unchanged: skip the create/skill.md command link and generate .claude/skills/create/SKILL.md with name create, giving twelve create:* commands plus the create skill Claude already shows; its cost is that .claude/skills is today one symlink to ../.skilled/skills so the tree must become managed, and other runtimes cost 0.

Option 2, the case-only mirror name SKILL.md, is the cheapest change (one special case in buildExpectedLinks, no canonical edit, no other runtime) but its effect is unmeasured because g5 tested skill.md against new-skill.md and never the uppercase spelling; if Claude's rule is case-insensitive the script would print a false 44/44, so one throwaway Claude listing must run first.

Option 3, a nested entrypoint at create/skill/index.md, would keep the name and remove the collapse if Claude resolves a folder index as the folder's command, but the resolution is UNKNOWN and may render as create:skill:index; cost is one path special case and zero elsewhere.

Option 4, a colon-named root mirror create:skill.md, cannot collapse because it has no folder, but whether Claude derives create:skill from that filename is UNKNOWN and a colon is illegal on Windows, so the mirror would not survive a Windows checkout.

Option 5, dropping the collapsed file from the Claude mirror, shows the twelve siblings and loses the create entry: 43 of 44, an honest one-surface loss rather than a false 44, with one link removed and zero cost elsewhere.
Renaming the canonical create/skill.md is excluded because it changes the command name on all six runtimes at once, and the 011 allowlist already records that as the reason the case stays open.
